notes.title: Streaming Guidelines
notes.notes:
[p]【Streaming Guidelines】[/p][p][/p][p]We permit livestreaming and gameplay videos of this game for both individuals and organizations, regardless of whether it is for commercial or non-commercial purposes. Please adhere to the following guidelines when doing so.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]【Basic Guidelines】[/b][/p][p]▼ When playing the game, be sure to follow the operation instructions and safety directions provided within the game.[/p][p]▼ When uploading or livestreaming videos, please include the following text either in the video itself or in the description:[/p][p][/p][p]『I scream Ice cream』©面白法人カヤック[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3700280/I_scream_Ice_cream/"]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3700280/I_scream_Ice_cream/[/url][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]【Prohibited Actions】[/b][/p][p]▼ Do not edit and post the game content as part of unrelated videos. Also, do not use the game in ways that significantly damage its image or violate public order and morals.[/p][p]▼ Do not engage in slander, harassment, or any disruptive behavior toward other players.[/p][p]▼ Do not extract and upload individual elements of the game (e.g., visuals, music, voice, design) separately.
Example: Extracting only the BGM and using it in another video project.[/p][p]▼ Commercial or profit-oriented use of the posted videos is prohibited. However, if the video is freely accessible on a video sharing platform and the platform's officially provided features (e.g., YouTube Partner Program) generate incidental revenue, this will not be considered for-profit use. These features may be used without issue.
For other types of corporate use, please contact us individually.[/p][p]▼ Do not infringe upon the rights of third parties (including intellectual property rights, reputation, credibility, likeness, privacy, etc.) or engage in activities that may lead to such infringement. If any trouble arises with a third party in connection to the use of gameplay footage, it must be resolved at your own responsibility. The developer assumes no liability, so please be aware in advance.[/p][p]※ Regardless of reason, if the developer requests content removal, please comply promptly.[/p][p]※ Please note that we cannot respond to individual inquiries regarding the developer's actions or decisions about submitted content. Thank you for your understanding.[/p]
